WITH TEMP_CUR AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A, 0)), 0) AMOUNT FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{startDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('1102', '1111', '1112', '1113', '1114', '1115', '1116') AND INFO.INDUSTRY = '10' ), TEMP_LAST AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A, 0)), 0) AMOUNT FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('1102', '1111', '1112', '1113', '1114', '1115', '1116') AND INFO.INDUSTRY = '10' ) SELECT 'thamt1_3_4' AS propertycode, TEMP_CUR.AMOUNT AS sessionendNum, TEMP_LAST.AMOUNT AS lastSessionendNum FROM TEMP_CUR, TEMP_LAST

SELECT 'samt1_3' propertycode, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A), 0) FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{startDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND CMAP.ASSETTYPE = '12' AND FPT.TYPE_12 = '106' ) AS nonsStandardAmount, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A), 0) FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND CMAP.ASSETTYPE = '12' AND FPT.TYPE_12 = '106' ) AS lastNonsStandardAmount, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A), 0) FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{startDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND CMAP.ASSETTYPE = '12' AND FPT.TYPE_12 != '106' ) AS otherAmount, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_A), 0) FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON FPT.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND CMAP.ASSETTYPE = '12' AND FPT.TYPE_12 != '106' ) AS lastOtherAmount FROM DUAL

select CM.ASSET_CODE assetcode,sum(CM.ASSETVALUE_A) sessionendNum from CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION cm left join CHB_ASSET_INFO ca on CM.ASSET_CODE=CA.ASSET_CODE and CA.STATUS !='D' where CA.ASSET_TYPE='12' and CM.ENDDATE=#{endDate, jdbcType = DATE} and CM.ASSETVALUE_A !=0 group by CM.ASSET_CODE

SELECT 't3_36_amt' propertycode, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_B), 0) FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE
WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{startDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('1106', '2401', '1303', '2403','2402','2499') AND ((INFO.IS_GOVERN_FUND is not null and INFO.IS_GOVERN_FUND!='01' ) or INFO.IS_GOVERN_FUND is null) ) AS indInvestmentAmount, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_B), 0) FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE
WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('1106', '2401', '1303', '2403','2402','2499') AND ((INFO.IS_GOVERN_FUND is not null and INFO.IS_GOVERN_FUND!='01' ) or INFO.IS_GOVERN_FUND is null) ) AS lastIndInvestmentAmount, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_B), 0) FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE
WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{startDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND (INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('1301', '1305', '1302', '1399') or (INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 ='1299' and INFO.IN_ASSET_TYPE IN ('01','02')))
) AS otherAmount, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_B), 0) FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION CMAP LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO INFO ON CMAP.ASSET_CODE = INFO.ASSET_CODE
WHERE CMAP.STARTDATE = #{lastStartDate, jdbcType = DATE} AND (INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('1301', '1305', '1302', '1399') or (INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 ='1299' and INFO.IN_ASSET_TYPE IN ('01','02'))) ) AS lastOtherAmount, ( select REPLACE(to_char(wm_concat(t.remark)),',','、') reamrk from ( select nvl(info.asset_name,info.asset_code)||'+'||to_char(nvl(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_B,0)) AS remark ,nvl(CMAP.ASSETVALUE_B,0) as balance,data.pos_amt as posAmt,row_number() over(order by CMAP.ASSETVALUE_B desc) as idx from chb_month_asset_position cmap left join chb_asset_info info ON cmap.asset_code=info.asset_code left join chb_assets_basis_data data on cmap.asset_code=data.asset_id and data.value_date=#{endDate, jdbcType = DATE}
where CMAP.STARTDATE = #{startDate, jdbcType = DATE} and cmap.ASSETVALUE_B is not null AND (INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('1301', '1305', '1302', '1399') or (INFO.ASSET_TYPE2 ='1299' and INFO.IN_ASSET_TYPE IN ('01','02'))) order by CMAP.ASSETVALUE_B desc ) t where t.idx<= 3 or t.posAmt>=1000000000 ) as remark
FROM DUAL
